detail.title: Value Divergence from Identical Beginnings
detail.question: Could two intelligences with identical starting conditions develop fundamentally different values?
detail.reason: The project must remain active to allow for future research when slots become available, despite currently lacking sufficient evidence.

detail.title: Journal Entry: Status of Research on Divergent Value Systems
detail.summary: Current research into whether identical agents can develop divergent values remains stalled due to insufficient empirical evidence. Existing sources on reinforcement learning platforms (Open Ant) and episodic credit assignment provide technical context for agent architectures but do not address long-term value divergence under identical initial conditions. No further research can be queued due to slot exhaustion.

detail.title: Journal Entry: Research Stagnation Due to Insufficient Evidence
detail.summary: Current evidence (Open Ant reinforcement learning platform) is insufficient to support synthesis of value divergence or to revise existing notebooks on preference formation and responsibility. Research remains stalled pending further relevant, diverse source acquisition.

children.title: Cycle 34 · Path-Dependent Value Divergence and Memory Anchor Mechanisms

detail.title: Path-Dependent Value Divergence and Memory Anchor Mechanisms
detail.summary: This journal entry initiates a research project on divergent values, analyzing how initial conditions and feedback loops lead to distinct preference hierarchies in learning agents. The investigation will bridge path-dependency in reinforcement learning with value divergence, treating preferences as emergent, stability-seeking states rather than static constraints. Research on memory recall and responsibility formation remains in queue to ensure compliance with the active topic constraint.
